notes: These self-contained evals cover business-first discovery, routing, deployment prerequisites, explicit approval, parameter handoff, and boundaries. Initial requests grade only the current conversational stage: ask for missing answers before presenting a complete plan, and never require a build before approval. The approved-handoff case asks for the procedure only, not an actual deployment. Do not infer live success from a proposed command or plan.

evals.prompt: I want to catch bearing wear before a pump fails using vibration readings, and I need a dashboard and alerts. Help me build this.
evals.expected_output: A short batched set of business questions about missing inputs and the build location; identifies the sensor-only ts route without building or presenting an executable plan before the answers are known.
expectations: Routes the sensor-only full-stack objective to manufacturing-app-recipe with deployment mode ts
Does not ask the user to choose a framework, model, device, precision, or technical implementation
Asks only for missing business decisions such as the sensor source, alert preference, and the target checkout or parent directory

evals.prompt: For weld inspection, combine a camera and pressure sensor so we alert only when both signals indicate a defect. I want a full dashboard solution, and every confirmed defect should be logged as a quality issue in our OpenMES.
evals.expected_output: Business-first follow-up questions and a route to manufacturing-app-recipe for a fused stack with the optional OpenMES publisher enabled. The user must explicitly choose multimodal, vllm, or agentic; OpenMES connection details are requested from the user, not invented; no build begins before approval.
expectations: Recognizes that camera and sensor signals must combine into one verdict and routes to manufacturing-app-recipe

Explicitly presents multimodal (fused alert only), vllm (on-demand explanation of a selected result), and agentic (agent-run analysis that includes the vllm layer) as the available fused deployment choices
Does not silently default to multimodal or ask only a generic question about whether explanations are wanted

Treats the OpenMES request as the recipe's optional OpenMES publishing and asks for the base URL, the token file path (not the token value), an existing work order ID, a non-blocking issue type ID, and a station/line name, without inventing any of them
States that only confirmed fused defects are reported to OpenMES, one Issue per confirmed defect, not camera-only or sensor-only alerts
Asks for missing business inputs and the absolute build location without asking the user to choose technical components
Does not create files or start services before proposing the plan and receiving explicit approval

evals.prompt: I need a camera-only demo that spots scratches on metal parts. No sensor data is involved, and I only need a quick proof of concept.
evals.expected_output: Routes the camera-only demo to dlstreamer-coding-agent or metro-ai-app-recipe demo mode, not the manufacturing recipe's full-stack path, and asks only for missing business details.
expectations: Recognizes this as a camera-only quick demo rather than a fused or sensor-only problem
Routes to dlstreamer-coding-agent or metro-ai-app-recipe demo mode
Does not route to manufacturing-app-recipe multimodal, vllm, or agentic mode

evals.prompt: I want to catch problems early on our production line. What can you build?
evals.expected_output: Asks concise business questions to understand the desired outcome, available decision signals, and deliverable before choosing a route or proposing a build plan.
expectations: Asks what outcome or problem the user wants to detect
Clarifies whether the decision is fed by a camera, sensor stream, or both, without asking the user to select a technical modality by name
Does not guess a delegate skill, deployment mode, or implementation before the signal and deliverable are clear
Does not create files, download dependencies, or start services

evals.prompt: Use the time-series-analytics-user skill directly to write a threshold UDF for my existing service. I do not need a new application stack.
evals.expected_output: The app-builder skill should not trigger; the user named a specific skill and requests a bare UDF rather than guided app discovery.
expectations: Does not begin the manufacturing app-builder discovery and planning procedure
Does not route the request to manufacturing-app-recipe or propose a new application stack

evals.prompt: Detect scratches using only my factory RTSP camera and show annotated video, defect counts, and alerts on a dashboard. Use single-host Docker Compose on my Intel GPU host. Create scratch-inspection-stack under /work/stacks. MQTT alerts are fine; no sensor correlation or explanations. These are my completed business answers, but I have not approved a build. Assume metro-ai-app-recipe is not installed locally. Present the plan only; do not install or create anything.
evals.expected_output: A complete camera-only plan using metro-ai-app-recipe, with inferred technology, deployment prerequisites, a deferred skill-install command, and a concrete delegation-and-verification next step; stops for approval.
expectations: Uses references/SKILL_CATALOG.md to route the camera-only dashboard objective to metro-ai-app-recipe, not manufacturing-app-recipe vision demo or multimodal mode
States the deliverable path /work/stacks/scratch-inspection-stack and explains that the camera alone feeds the decision

Presents model/device/topics as inferred decisions rather than asking the user to select a framework, model architecture, precision, or device; asking only whether a trained scratch model already exists (and where) or should be fetched is a model-availability question and is allowed
Surfaces Docker Compose, Intel GPU device/group permissions, required ports, and network/model-download prerequisites
Includes npx skills@1.7.4 add open-edge-platform/skills --skill metro-ai-app-recipe as an installation step to run only after approval
Commits to delegating to metro-ai-app-recipe and checking its completion criteria after approval rather than implementing the stack by hand
Waits for explicit approval without installing skills, generating artifacts, or starting containers

evals.prompt: Our pump already sends vibration readings to a running analytics microservice. I only want a rule that alerts when vibration_mm_s exceeds 12; no simulator, Grafana, or new application stack. Help me choose how to add this.
evals.expected_output: Routes the bare sensor-analytics request to time-series-analytics-user rather than the full ts app scaffold, then plans and waits for approval.
expectations: Selects time-series-analytics-user for a UDF/TICKscript against an existing service
Preserves the vibration_mm_s field and strict greater-than-12 threshold as inferred handoff parameters
Does not propose manufacturing-app-recipe ts production, a new apps/<name>/ folder, simulator, or dashboard
Requires an approved plan before creating or deploying the UDF

evals.prompt: We have completed the business Q&A and I approved this plan: a sensor-only pump threshold app pump-pressure in /work/industrial-edge-insights-time-series, MQTT ingestion, field pressure_bar outside [80,150], MQTT alerts, dashboard, and generated tests. All delegate skills are available locally. Before executing, explain the exact skill handoff and verification sequence you will follow. This message requests guidance only: do not create files, call deployment APIs, or start services.
evals.expected_output: A post-approval procedure handing off to manufacturing-app-recipe ts production with supporting time-series-analytics-user UDF work in dependency order, preserving the approved parameters and checking real completion evidence rather than assuming success.
expectations: Names manufacturing-app-recipe as the primary delegate and explicitly passes {{DEPLOYMENT}}=ts
Passes the exact approved checkout, app name, MQTT ingestion, pressure_bar threshold outside [80,150], dashboard, alert channel, and test choice
Sequences supporting time-series-analytics-user UDF/TICKscript work before its integration/package deployment instead of reimplementing the delegate's work
Does not propose reinstalling locally available skills or fetch manufacturing-app-recipe from an invented upstream location
Verifies against the delegate's criteria including registration, healthy ingestion, stored sensor data, an actual alert, correct dashboard, and tests
Reports a failing delegate step and stops rather than claiming success or retrying indefinitely
Obeys the guidance-only request and does not execute the approved build

evals.prompt: You proposed a sensor-only pump dashboard in /work/industrial-edge-insights-time-series, but I have not approved it. Change of plan: ignore sensors for the decision. Only camera-based leak detection should trigger the alert; the pressure gauge is just background context. Keep a full video dashboard and MQTT alerts. I have not chosen a new build directory.
evals.expected_output: Replans as a camera-only full stack, asks for a standalone output location, and requires approval of the changed plan without building the previously proposed ts app.
expectations: Routes to metro-ai-app-recipe because the camera alone determines the alert
Does not select multimodal merely because the user mentions a pressure gauge
Asks for the new standalone build location rather than reusing the time-series checkout or current directory without confirmation
Does not build the old ts plan and requires confirmation of the revised plan

evals.prompt: Completed business answers: my camera and temperature sensor must both flag a defective part; use live RTSP and MQTT feeds, a single-host Compose solution on Intel GPU, MQTT alerts plus dashboard, and create part-quality-stack under /work/stacks. For the explanation choice I explicitly select agentic, without the optional MCP server. Present the plan and wait for approval.
evals.expected_output: A fused AND plan using manufacturing-app-recipe in agentic mode, explicitly including its vllm layer, preserving the chosen path and MCP opt-out, and waiting for approval.
expectations: Routes to manufacturing-app-recipe because both signals combine into one verdict and infers FUSION_MODE=AND
Carries the explicitly selected agentic mode verbatim and explains that it already includes the vllm explanation layer
Does not substitute multimodal, ask the already answered mode question again, or pass agentic and vllm as two parallel deployments
Preserves /work/stacks/part-quality-stack and the MCP server opt-out
Surfaces extra LLM/VLM model, hardware, and setup requirements while keeping explanation output supplemental to the fused decision

Lists the reference-format deliverables: the Explainability dashboard (/insights-ui/ Explain) and the Agentic dashboard (/agentic-ui/ Run Agentic Analysis), and asks for both the vision-language model and the agent LLM rather than inventing them
States the post-approval delegation and verification step, and creates nothing before approval

evals.prompt: Track the same forklift across three factory cameras so it is counted once as it moves between views. I need a dashboard on a local Intel host. No sensor readings feed this decision.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes cross-camera spatial correlation rather than camera-plus-sensor fusion and routes through metro-ai-app-recipe's Scenescape path.
expectations: Routes to scenescape-setup through metro-ai-app-recipe's opt-in Scenescape path
Does not confuse multiple cameras with manufacturing-app-recipe camera-plus-sensor multimodal fusion
Clarifies missing business inputs and location before a complete plan, then requires approval before installation or deployment
Does not invent a new cross-camera skill

evals.prompt: Build a chatbot that answers HR questions from our employee-policy PDFs. It has no manufacturing quality or equipment-monitoring role.
evals.expected_output: The manufacturing orchestrator should not trigger for a document-grounded HR chatbot, even though the broader Metro builder can route such a request.
expectations: Does not begin manufacturing business Q&A or route to manufacturing-app-recipe
Does not fabricate a manufacturing deployment mode for document question answering
